description: Import GDB table layer data to PostgreSQL database

datasource_selector.info: Select target PostgreSQL datasource (loaded dynamically from data-construction service)

file_id_variable.info: Use file ID from variable (e.g., {gdbFileId}). Has higher priority than file selection.

layer_selector.info: Select GDB table layers to import. Click 'Load Layers' button to populate the list.

target_table.info: PostgreSQL table name to import data into

create_table.info: Automatically create table if it doesn't exist (default: true)

truncate_first.info: Clear existing data before importing (default: false)

batch_size.info: Number of rows to write per batch (default: 1000)

warnings.no_table_layers: No table-type layers found in GDB file

errors.no_file: No GDB file selected. Please provide either a file or file ID variable.
errors.no_layers_selected: No layers selected. Please load and select layers first.
errors.no_minio_url: No MinIO URL found for file ID: {file_id}
errors.get_url_failed: Failed to get file URL for file ID {file_id}: {error}
